products.heading: Our Premium Artificial Turf Collection
products.body: All turf is sold in 15-foot wide rolls. *Heavier face weight* = built for high-traffic areas, pets, and long-term durability (backyards, commercial applications). *Lighter face weight* = ideal for aesthetic, low-traffic zones like front yards and landscaping accents.
products.note: Pricing below is standard retail per square foot. Contractors — call or text for exclusive wholesale pricing.

series.label: Natural Blend Series
series.heading: Natural Blend Series
series.intro: Our [Natural Blend Series](/natural-series) offers a beautiful, realistic look that closely mimics natural grass. Perfect for light to moderate foot traffic front yards, side yards, and decorative landscaping.

series.label: Winter Blend Series
series.heading: Winter Blend Series
series.intro: The [Winter Blend Series](/winter-series) features a specialized "Notify" Emerald & Lime palette — a lush, cool-toned green that stays vibrant year-round even under intense Arizona sun. *Winter Blend 103 is ideal for moderate-to-heavy traffic areas.*

series.label: Spring Blend Series
series.heading: Spring Blend Series
series.intro: Our [Spring Blend](/spring-blend) is a vibrant, plush collection using "Billow" Emerald coloring for maximum curb appeal. *Spring Blend 107 offers supreme density — our top recommendation for heavy backyard use and busy pet families.*

series.label: Bermuda Blend Series
series.heading: Bermuda Blend Series
series.intro: The [Bermuda Blend Series](/bermuda-blend) is designed to replicate the earthy, natural look of real Bermuda grass with an Olive & Green "Chant" tone. A natural-looking, lower-profile option that blends seamlessly into desert landscaping.

series.label: Specialty
series.heading: Putting Greens
series.intro: Engineered for a true, consistent roll — bring your backyard golf game to the next level with our [Putting Green](/putting-green) turf.

items.question: How wide are your turf rolls?
items.answer: All of our turf is sold in standard 15-foot wide rolls. When you bring in your measurements, we can help you plan your cuts to minimize waste and save money.

items.question: Can I get a sample before I buy?
items.answer: Absolutely. Visit our Queen Creek showroom and take home free samples from any product in our collection. See and feel the quality before you commit.

items.question: What's the difference between face weight and pile height?
items.answer: Face weight (measured in ounces) refers to how much fiber is packed into the turf — more ounces means a denser, more durable product. Pile height is how tall the blades stand. For high-traffic areas and pets, we recommend 90+ oz face weight.
